performance.title: Performance

hints.pl: Cumulative profit/loss on each day: realized + unrealized + dividends. Green dot = highest, red dot = lowest in this period.
hints.plPct: Cumulative profit/loss as a percentage of the money you had put in by that day. Adding money changes this ratio even if prices don't move.
hints.value: Total value (holdings + cash in the safe) against the money you brought in from outside (dashed).
hints.performance: Time-weighted return: how your investments performed with the effect of adding money removed, rebased to 0% at the start of the period. BIST 100 is a price index (excludes dividends). Shaded area = largest drawdown.

performance.returnHint: Time-weighted return: performance of your holdings, not affected by when you added money.
performance.drawdownHint: Largest fall from a high point to a later low, measured on the time-weighted return.
performance.notRecovered: Not recovered yet · now {{value}} from peak

monthly.title: Month by Month
monthly.hint: Values at each month's last trading day. Return is time-weighted (ignores money added); P/L change is in TL.

rightsIssues.title: Rights Issues
rightsIssues.hint: Yahoo doesn't report rights issues; it silently lowers earlier prices instead. For every rights issue listed here, past prices are restored to their real values. If you exercised your rights use "Exercised", if you sold them use "Sold"; if you did nothing, no transaction is needed.
